Student Loan Borrowers Face Payment Changes

Student loan borrowers in the United States who are exiting the SAVE (Saving on a Valuable Education) repayment plan may face significantly higher monthly payments if they do not take action soon. Additionally, student-debt relief is in limbo for borrowers pursuing a major forgiveness program for public servants.
